reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "focus"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "focus": it is about one thing at a time, so scenes open like an iris onto one thing. TikTok wants native editing, so hard cuts and whips lead.
Camera "dolly": constant forward movement for a high-energy feed.
Grounds light → light → accent → light: a warm accent, so light grounds lead and the accent is saved for the turns.
Sound-on placement: every transition, landing and reveal has a cue, and the bed ducks under the brand moment.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on TikTok (0.24s a word), inside 10–22s.
